## Prettifer {{TAG}}

Windows x64 build. Extract the ZIP anywhere and run `prettifer.exe`.
Git `2.30+` must be available on `PATH`.

Installation, usage and troubleshooting: [README](https://github.com/{{RELEASE_REPOSITORY}}#readme)

### Verify the download

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\prettifer-win32-x64-{{VERSION}}.zip -Algorithm SHA256
```

Expected SHA256: `{{SHA256}}`
